'''Zuggit''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located within the [[Zuggit system/Legends|Zuggit system]] of the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]] Territories.<ref name="TEA" /> It was the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of a twelve-foot tall, twin-headed, and [[Color/Legends|magenta]]-skinned [[Alien/Legends|alien]].<ref name="Insider 32">{{InsiderCite|32|The Wonder Column|The New Wonder Column}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Zuggit was mentioned in the seventh installment of [[The Wonder Column|''The New Wonder Column'']], written by [[Anthony Daniels]]. While omitted from the print edition of ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' and the first edition of its [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|online companion]], the [[Zuggit system/Legends|Zuggit system]] was later included in the online update.
